prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production native-transparent combat animation sprite sheet. The supplied reference montage: LEFT large portrait = approved IDENTITY/materials/palette ONLY; TOP RIGHT frog/troll/slime = USER APPROVED 0098 C CAMERA, reproduce this camera; BOTTOM RIGHT four actual map assets = SAME elevated game-map camera. Old tiny character at bottom LEFT = accessory information only, NOT camera.
CAMERA from 0098 candidate C: orthographic 2:1 dimetric, look DOWN at 42 degrees above horizontal, whole body facing SCREEN LOWER LEFT / SOUTHWEST, 3/4 FRONT. This is a camera reconstruction, not merely rotating a frontal portrait. Top surfaces of crown/helmet/head plus shoulders/back must occupy AT LEAST as much projected area as front/face/chest. Crown broad, face small and low, look down-left, forehead visible, chin tiny, far eye compressed. Foreshorten torso and lower body. Near and far feet stagger diagonally in depth. Preserve exact camera through ALL poses, no looking up to expose whole portrait face.
LAYOUT: wide 3072x1920 canvas, EXACTLY EIGHT equal columns and FIVE equal rows, 40 separated whole-body sprites. LEFT FOUR columns = SOUTHWEST 3/4 FRONT throughout. RIGHT FOUR = NORTHEAST / SCREEN UPPER RIGHT 3/4 BACK throughout: back of head/back/heels, NO frontal face on NE, NEVER use front-facing mirror. Same elevated camera for both directions. SAME uniform scale and proportions in all cells, generous transparent gutters 15% of cell, all props/limbs inside individual cell. No sprite touches another.
Each half has SAME pose order read left-to-right: ROW1 idle relaxed, idle breathing, defeated kneeling/slumped, defeated resting on ground. ROW2 four consecutive walking/moving poses. ROW3 attack windup, strike toward facing direction, contact, recover. ROW4 skill gather, prepare, strongest expression, settle. ROW5 four distinct HIT reactions: startle, recoil, compress, recover. Exactly 20 poses/direction. All poses visibly distinct. Feet/body contact at x50% y85% of cell. Tiny naturally generated translucent horizontal 2:1 elliptical contact shadow centered directly under each character, no long cast shadow, no floor. For candle use wax base contact, for rats whole group. Softly shaded dimensional hand-painted chibi miniatures matching portrait, crisp readable edges, no pixel art.
GENUINELY TRANSPARENT RGBA background and gutters, retain native alpha, NO painted background/checkerboard/grid/borders/text/numbers/labels/scenery. Draw only the sprites, NOT reference board or frog/troll/slime/map props. No new accessories, no detached particle trails.
IDENTITY: ONE empty stocky silver/steel medieval armor, bronze rivets, dark hollow visor with exactly two warm amber glowing eyes, crimson ragged plume and torn red cape/scarf, leather belt, plated gauntlets and boots. Preserve asymmetrical battered spiked shoulder plate. NO sword/shield/new weapon; attacks use own gauntlets. Helmet TOP broad ellipse and shoulder TOP plates dominate over short visor/chest; compact short legs.
rejection: S 미충족; 북동 일부 복귀 포즈 정면
